# Convert declination string to numeric degrees for comparison
def declination_to_degrees(dec_str):
    # Assuming format like " degree22′44″" or " degree20′53″"
    # Remove " degree" and split by ′ and ″
    cleaned = dec_str.replace(' degree', '').replace('′', ' ').replace('″', '')
    parts = cleaned.split()
    degrees = float(parts[0])
    minutes = float(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0.0
    seconds = float(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0.0
    return degrees + minutes/60 + seconds/3600

spiral_df['declination_numeric'] = spiral_df['declination ( j2000 )'].apply(declination_to_degrees)
